sources.title: ILOSTAT — Profil pays Bénin
sources.scope: National labour-market context; not an individual occupation wage table.
sources.limitation: The source currently identified does not provide a validated low/median/high salary range for each of the 115 M-TIER occupations.

sources.title: BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook — occupational pay and training
sources.scope: Occupation profiles with median pay, education/training and outlook; US only.
sources.limitation: A validated occupation-code match is required; BLS median pay alone is not a low/median/high range.

sources.title: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
sources.scope: Occupation-level wage percentiles and geographic breakdowns; US only.
sources.limitation: Requires verified SOC/O*NET crosswalk and reference-year selection for each occupation.

sources.title: Government of Canada Job Bank — wage reports
sources.scope: Low, median and high wages by occupation and Canadian location.
sources.limitation: Requires verified NOC mapping and geographic selection for each occupation.

sources.title: INSEE — salaires et revenus salariaux
sources.scope: French wage statistics by socio-professional category and territory.
sources.limitation: Not every M-TIER occupation has a direct PCS-level match; broad category averages must not be presented as occupation-specific estimates.

sources.title: ONS — Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings
sources.scope: UK earnings statistics by SOC occupational classification.
sources.limitation: Requires verified SOC mapping; some public tables are aggregated at broad occupation levels.
